invariants: Nothing is published, and none of the user 20 KEEP decisions are changed.
All photograph candidate uploads must show the exact named object, not a generic church.
A title or internal shrine dedication does NOT establish the principal physical statue, tilma or icon.
Guide stops must be physically contained at the correct Place; no offsite accidental assignments.
Apparition events cannot have literal event photographs; use independently documented physical marker if relevant.
Relic authenticity claims remain attributed to sources, never app-certified.
Source registry links are research starting points, not proof a website page still resolves or grants image copyright.
Wikimedia categories do not grant licences, and visual rights/photo quality still need individual review.
No automated object-media publication, no overwrite of site heroes, no new payment or rights-holder contact.
